eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Jackson, OR; at 6:18 PM on AUG 13, 2026 Effective until 10:18 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Wildfire Alert - Jackson County Sheriff's Office has issued a Level 1 BE READY to evacuate for JAC-037 near Fielder Creek Road W Evans north of Fielder Creek rd due to I5 Mile Marker 51 Fire. Monitor local news sources for evacuation and incident information.
